name: @pipeworx/mcp-jupiter

tools.name: jupiter_price
tools.description: USD price, 24h change, and aggregated liquidity for one or more Solana token mints, aggregated by Jupiter across every DEX/AMM it indexes (not a single pool — use the dexscreener pack for one specific pool). Up to 50 mints per call.

mints.description: Solana token mint addresses (base58), e.g. ["So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"] for SOL. Max 50.

tools.name: jupiter_quote
tools.description: Best swap route and quote between two Solana token mints via Jupiter Aggregator — expected output amount, price impact, and the route (which AMMs/DEXes it crosses). Amount is in the INPUT token's base units (e.g. lamports for SOL: 1 SOL = 1_000_000_000).

amount.description: Amount of input_mint to swap, in base units (integer, as a string or number — e.g. "1000000000" for 1 SOL).

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points. Default 50 (0.5%).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-jupiter forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the jupiter pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
